FN-HPKG366-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 68
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/19/2024
House Bill 68 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Office of Information
Technology by a department-estimated $3.1 million in Fiscal Year 2025 and $1.4 million each
fiscal year thereafter by requiring the adoption of rules regarding sensitive personal information
held or accessible by certain state and local government entities.
This bill would also increase the obligations of state and local government entities by an
undetermined amount dependent on the cost to implement security measures to protect sensitive
personally identifying information against security breaches.
